replies.author: Zintenka
replies.body:
I'm trying to make a portal that will allow players to reselect their class should they not wish to play the current one that they're using. (Especially defenders since defenders won't be able to leave the monument tower)

But in order to do this their item and armor slots need to be cleared of any items so that there won't be any clutter in their inventory.
